title: UUIDv6 (reordered time, RFC 9562)
summary: UUID version 6 reorders the v1 timestamp into big-endian, time-ordered form so that UUIDs sort chronologically. It keeps the v1 node/clock fields for compatibility.

notes: time_high (32) + time_mid (16) + time_low (12) reordered to a 60-bit Unix timestamp in 100-ns units.
Clock sequence (14 bits) + node (48 bits) as in v1.
Lexicographically sortable by creation time; drop-in for systems keyed on v1.
